reference.engine: Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03 (pyswisseph), FLG_SWIEPH|FLG_SPEED, se1 sepl/semo/seas; return flag checked == FLG_SWIEPH on every call
reference.position: geocentric apparent ecliptic longitude, true ecliptic & equinox of date (light-time, aberration, deflection, nutation); Jupiter..Pluto = SE default
reference.timeAxis: TT seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 on the TT scale (= TimeScales.ttMs/1000); range ends converted from UTC with lib/astrology/time scalesFromUtc(pre1961=civil_as_ut)
reference.method: dense grid (600 s with Moon, else 7200 s); SE speed sign change -> turn (bisection); monotone segments; level-crossing bisection to 0.01 s; families via 800-day outside scan (7200 s)

legend.W: [key 'a>b|aspect|T' (natal) or 'a~b|aspect|T' (mundane), enterTT|null (startsBeforeRange), exitTT|null (endsAfterRange), passes [[tt, pass, of, cyclePass, cycleOf, cycleClippedByRange]], cls 1=single 2=multiple 3=tangential 0=none_in_range, nearApproaches [[tt, sepArcsec]], closest [tt, sepArcsec] (only when no exact) | null]
legend.M: key -> [[tt, sepArcsec]]: in-range turns whose |d-T| lies within 120 arcsec of 0 or of the orb (pass-count / window sensitivity)
legend.req: ScanRequest exactly as passed to the engine (UTC ms) + group/seStation/seLoop notes
